f-where.question: Where do you deliver?
f-where.answer: We deliver to all 23 districts of Vienna. Depending on the district, delivery is free or costs €4.90 or €7.90. Just enter the postcode of the recipient's address – you'll see straight away whether and when we can deliver and what delivery costs.

f-today.question: Can I still have flowers delivered today?
f-today.answer: Yes – if you order Monday to Saturday by 6:30 pm or on Sundays by 5:45 pm, we deliver the same day anywhere in Vienna, as long as a time slot is still available. You'll see the earliest delivery time for your address as soon as you enter the postcode.

f-date.question: Can I choose a specific delivery date?
f-date.answer: Yes. On every product page and at checkout, you choose your preferred date in the calendar. Days on which we don't deliver are greyed out.

f-window.question: Can I choose a preferred time?
f-window.answer: Yes. In Vienna, you choose a one-hour time slot between 9 am and 10 pm at checkout – on all seven days of the week.

f-nobody.question: What happens if nobody is home?
f-nobody.answer: The courier hands the flowers over in person. If nobody is there, they will be left with a neighbour where possible. At checkout, you can add a note for the delivery, for example a door code. We'll keep you updated on the status of your order by email.

f-anon.question: Can I send flowers anonymously?
f-anon.answer: Yes. Without a greeting card, your name doesn't appear anywhere on the bouquet, and the invoice goes only to you. Greeting cards with a personal message are coming soon.

f-card.question: Can I add a greeting card?
f-card.answer: Not yet – greeting cards are coming soon. Until then, the bouquet is delivered without a card.

f-photo.question: Do the flowers look exactly like the photo?
f-photo.answer: Every bouquet is tied individually, and flowers are natural products. Colours, varieties and bloom size may vary slightly depending on the season. The style and colour palette stay the same.

f-fresh.question: How do the flowers stay fresh?
f-fresh.answer: Every bouquet is freshly tied for your order and delivered directly by courier. To make it last as long as possible: cut the stems at an angle, add fresh water and keep the bouquet in a cool spot out of direct sunlight.

f-payment.question: What payment options are there?
f-payment.answer: You'll see the available payment methods in the last step of your order. Payment is processed securely by a payment provider – your card details never reach us.

f-change.question: Can I change my order?
f-change.answer: As long as the bouquet hasn't been tied yet, we can usually still change the delivery date or address. Write to us as soon as possible with your order number.

f-business.question: Can I send flowers to companies or hotels?
f-business.answer: Yes. At checkout, enter the company or hotel name and – if known – the department or room number. Delivery is made to the reception desk.

f-express.question: Do you offer express delivery?
f-express.answer: Yes – express delivery in 1–2 hours, at no extra cost. Just order as usual and choose today's earliest time slot at checkout – it is marked “Express”. This works if you order Monday to Saturday by 6:30 pm or on Sundays by 5:45 pm and a time slot is still free for your address.

sections.heading: How we work
paragraphs: Blumora is a Viennese online flower delivery service. You choose your bouquet with us – it is tied by a florist in Vienna we work with on a permanent basis. There, every bouquet is made by hand, for your order.
Greeting cards with your own message are coming soon.

sections.heading: The delivery
paragraphs: A courier picks up your bouquet directly from the florist and brings it to the recipient's address without any stops in between. We deliver to all 23 districts of Vienna – in the time slot of your choice: morning, afternoon or evening until 10 pm.
